title: Seminar in International Relations and World Politics; Workshop in Multi-Track Diplomacy
description:
Professor Edy Kaufman will be a guest co-instructor. The course will not meet after June 28.

This workshop will develop skills in multi-track diplomacy and apply them to search for common ground in the current conflict in Israel-Palestine. A simulation engaging influential civil society representatives will be facilitated by workshop instructors with over 30 years' experience working with this and other conflicts around the world.
